sla.measurement: Micrometer timers on the provider, compared against the consumer-side timeout

retry.backoff: exponential with full jitter, 100ms base, 1s cap

fallback: Fail the confirmation with a retryable 503 and persist nothing. Never fall back to a cached, replicated or default annual rate.
notes: Called before the transaction opens, so no database connection is held during the call.
Reading an already-confirmed subscription performs no catalogue call: the product columns are denormalised in the subscriptions row.
verification: Fault-injection test asserting the timeout, the retry count and the circuit-breaker transitions, plus a load test showing p99 inside the timeout.
